Class Etudiant

java.lang.Object
Utilisateur
Etudiant
public class Etudiant extends Utilisateur
Student with an id (numEtudiant) and a group (groupe). Can calculate his average on a Module and on all Modules, check if he participates in a Module, get his presence on a Module and get the Seance he was present in. Inherits from Utilisateur attributes

Team KALLAX
